purpose: Additive RAM-cache successor questions; historical and unchanged frozen general retrieval sets remain separate.

questions.query: How does the RAM-cache successor retain and activate an actual hot native World without reconstructing its source?
facts: HOT retains a unique-owned native World, Workbench coupling bundle and render exchange inside the existing adapter. It is not a CYPS byte buffer.
The exclusive SimulationWorker retains the matching MicroScenarioHost and Workbench sample epoch. Native receipt fences and a one-use Main ticket control the no-copy ownership swap.
A zero-debt deferred HOT return performs no target checkpoint filesystem read, full source construction, native CYPS deserialization or forced synchronous checkpoint publication.

questions.query: Does a hot cache hit or completed travel mean changes are durably saved?
facts: Residency, readiness, game-time debt and durability are independent. HOT plus dirty is legitimate in explicitly selected deferred mode.

One immutable bounded snapshot publishes on a serialized I/O thread; its ACK cannot overwrite newer resident mutations or clocks. Explicit Save all waits for the matching area and global-clock durable boundary.
Crash recovery restores the last valid published manifest. Unacknowledged RAM-only work is not promised to survive. Strict mode and cache-disabled fallback remain available.

Validated and budgeted WARM admission retains its verified accounted native interval even if publication fails. Strict activation still awaits durability; Retry reconciles the exact retained publication without rebuilding the active World or replaying ticks.

questions.query: How are hot warm cold memory and eviction bounded, and is the configured cache budget a strict RSS limit?
facts: Native owned bytes and conservative growth reservation are accounted separately from warm bytes, host envelopes and pending preparation. Active and in-flight state is pinned; dirty-only copies cannot be evicted.

Private cold preparation reserves three native growth bounds plus 64 MiB; ordinary cold preparation reserves two growth bounds plus 64 MiB. Essential publication has one separate bounded 360 MiB working reservation.

The cache admission policy is not a process RSS bound. Allocator retention, OS thread stacks, Godot scene/UI and GPU resources remain separately measured. Only three 512 by 512 fixtures are qualified.

questions.query: Can predictive preparation advance a destination while global time changes, without double-counting its simulation?
facts: Declared adjacency, explicit travel intent and editor/camera boundary signals schedule one bounded private preparation. Native candidates are joined and imported before activation admission; they never share the active adapter during construction.

Background catch-up pays only legitimate G minus A debt using actual native ticks. Area-local incarnation, native and accounted fences reject replay while allowing unrelated active global ticks to continue.
Partial completed work is retained and credited once; remaining debt stays visible. A ready HOT entry is not necessarily fully caught up or durably saved.

questions.query: What happens after a late handoff acknowledgement or a failed active World with healthy dirty inactive areas?
facts: Late native, Main and release acknowledgements reconcile the exact pending transaction and retained receipts; retry cannot silently restore an older durable World over newer RAM state.

Resident advancement retains its original clock, debt/future plan, accounted prefix and exact pending request through timeout and release. Retry admits only the proven contiguous native interval once, without turning debt into new global time.
A failed active owner stays quarantined. Save recoverable areas preserves healthy inactive captures with a bounded honest recovery clock; it never claims an ordinary Save all.

A known terminal active failure retires its request only after exact receipt reconciliation and native release. The failing tick receives no credit; ambiguous or failed inactive results remain pinned.

Lost publication ACK recovery reopens storage and validates the exact published rescue manifest. Explicit recovery close warns about the failed area’s unsaved RAM loss; ordinary exit cannot silently discard it.

questions.query: What remains outside the three-stage RAM-cache milestone and how is physical Windows NVIDIA acceptance distinguished?
facts: The opt-in Draft/HOLD successor supports the existing actor-free Current/FreeMass native continuation domain on three authored 512 by 512 areas.
General chunk streaming, arbitrary actor/Rapier/controller persistence, Wave/PressureFlow/inertial continuations, cross-area material flux and recipe reconciliation remain outside scope.

Source-bound Linux/Windows graphical/native and sanitizer evidence is recorded in the dated ledger. Hosted software-renderer results do not establish physical Windows 11/NVIDIA performance or owner acceptance.
